anchors.quote: A license overrides that default and permits the activity.

anchors.code_excerpt: exception permitRule definition allowed under condition licensed and suspended consequence equals false
anchors.quote: Suspension is an exception to the licensing exception and denies permission even if licensed.

anchors.code_excerpt: label baseRule definition allowed equals false
anchors.quote: Suspension without a license does not grant permission.

assumptions: The supplied booleans completely describe licensing and suspension for the activity being evaluated.
value.interpretation: Permission defaults to denied. Licensing permits the activity, subject to a further exception denying permission when licensed and suspended. Thus permission is allowed exactly when licensed and not suspended; suspension without licensing leaves the default denial in force.
